targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', timestamp) AS INTEGER) as time, CASE WHEN temp_sensor_1 BETWEEN -25 AND 140 THEN temp_sensor_1 ELSE NULL END as 'F1 Kollektor', CASE WHEN temp_sensor_3 BETWEEN 10 AND 95 THEN temp_sensor_3 ELSE NULL END as 'F3 Puffer Unten', CASE WHEN pump_speed_a1 BETWEEN 0 AND 100 THEN pump_speed_a1 ELSE 0 END as 'A1 Solarpumpe %' FROM measurements WHERE timestamp >= datetime($__from/1000, 'unixepoch') AND timestamp <= datetime($__to/1000, 'unixepoch') ORDER BY timestamp ASC
